metadata.title: COBO Mobile SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned, Business-Operated (COBO) Mobile devices within the Secure-Mobile architecture.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all constraints, guardrails, and trust semantics from the Secure-Mobile Platform SSPP.

system-characteristics.system-description: COBO Mobile devices are institution-owned mobile devices operated strictly for business purposes. They provide a high level of administrative control and policy enforcement while remaining constrained to signal-based trust and non-execution semantics under the Secure-Mobile model.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: The institution owns and controls the mobile hardware.

props.name: use-model
props.remarks: COBO Mobile devices are restricted to institutional business use only.

props.name: management-authority
props.remarks: The institution retains full management, configuration, and wipe authority.

props.name: container-model
props.remarks: All data and applications on the device are institution-managed.

props.name: execution-trust
props.remarks: COBO Mobile devices are never treated as trusted execution environments.

props.name: daw-eligibility
props.remarks: COBO Mobile devices may not be used for DAW or privileged access workflows.

props.name: baseline-security-posture
props.remarks: COBO Mobile enforces baseline hardening (CIS L2), continuous health evaluation, and runtime threat protection.

props.name: admin-context
props.remarks: Administrative, break-glass, and emergency override contexts are not supported on COBO Mobile.

props.name: data-classification-ceiling
props.remarks: COBO Mobile devices may access data up to Classification Level 3, subject to Secure-Mobile containment rules.

system-implementation.remarks: COBO Mobile is implemented by applying the full Secure-Mobile pattern stack with institution-wide enforcement. Unlike COPE or BYOD Mobile, COBO Mobile does not require privacy separation between personal and managed data due to its business-only usage model.

roles.title: COBO Mobile Service Owner
roles.remarks: Owns the COBO Mobile service offering and ensures adherence to Secure-Mobile constraints.

roles.title: COBO Mobile Operations
roles.remarks: Operates COBO Mobile devices, posture services, and lifecycle actions in accordance with this SSPP.

control-implementation.remarks: Security and privacy controls are inherited from the Secure-Mobile Platform and enforced through pattern-conformant mobile management and access systems. This SSPP does not restate individual control implementations.
